{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Stratify by severity: compute response rate within each severity level
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='severity')

# Compute within-severity differences in response rate: treatment - control
within_severity_diff = response_rates.loc['treatment'] - response_rates.loc['control']

# Print response rates by arm and severity
print('Response rates by arm and severity:')
print(response_rates)
print('\nWithin-severity treatment effect (treatment - control):')
print(within_severity_diff)

# Compute overall treatment effect using standardisation (weighted average of stratum-specific effects)
# Use control group as reference for weights
n_control = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control'].groupby('severity').size()
n_total = df_dedup.groupby('severity').size()
weights = n_control / n_total  # weights based on control distribution

# Standardised treatment effect: weighted average of within-severity differences
standardised_effect = (within_severity_diff * weights).sum()

print(f'\nStandardised treatment effect (weighted by control severity distribution): {standardised_effect:.4f}')"}
